write_up: Your resume makes a strong case for operations supervision! It follows your progression from mechanic to Platoon Sergeant and shows the people, equipment, and budgets you managed, along with what changed under your leadership.

The vehicle readiness line is the model: it gives the starting and ending rates and names the changes you made to get there. Your supply chain degree is clearly marked as in progress, and your recent Army work is easy to follow.

Add a little detail about what logistics support included during the field exercises, then let the rest of this resume do its work. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back on its own; the job's requirements and how competitive it is will matter too.
